landing.pro1.headline: Logo and brand design
landing.pro1.reason: Simple logo systems and brand kits for small shops — marks that read cleanly in Burmese and English.
landing.pro2.headline: Business websites
landing.pro2.reason: Fast marketing sites for small businesses that stay usable on mid-range Androids and patchy 3G.
landing.pro3.headline: Facebook / Instagram management
landing.pro3.reason: Monthly content calendars and page management that stay consistent without sounding templated.
landing.howSubhead: Three steps. No account required to start describing.
landing.step1.title: Describe your goal
landing.step1.body: Write it the way you'd tell a friend — Burmese or English is fine.
landing.step2.title: Answer a few questions
landing.step2.body: We clarify budget, timing, and taste. Skip anything you're unsure about.
landing.step3.title: Meet three matches
landing.step3.body: See why each professional fits — then message the one you trust.
landing.commit1: Messages are deleted automatically after 90 days.
landing.commit2: We never ask for NRC or any government ID.
landing.commit3: Every professional is portfolio-reviewed by hand.

converse.title: A few questions
converse.clarifyQuestion: Got it. Are you looking to hire for one specific thing (logo, website, photos), or do you want a step-by-step plan for a bigger goal?
converse.unrelatedRedirect: That's outside what I help with here. If you're hiring for logo, website, photography, or social media — or planning a shop launch — say what you're working on.
